names.create:clipboard.tooltip.behaviour1: Opens the _Interface_. _Sneak-Click_ to _place_ it on a surface.

names.create:copycat_step.tooltip.summary: _Converts_ any _full block_ into a decorative step.

names.create:creative_crate.tooltip.summary: This _Storage Container_ allows infinite replication of items.
names.create:cuckoo_clock.tooltip.behaviour1: Shows the _current time_ and plays a tune twice a day. _Activates_ once at _noon_ and at dusk, as soon as _players can sleep_.

names.create:metal_bracket.tooltip.summary: _Decorate_ your _Shafts, Cogwheels_ and _Pipes_ with an industrial and sturdy bit of reinforcement.

names.create:turntable.tooltip.summary: Uses _Rotational Force_ to create Motion Sickness.
names.create:wooden_bracket.tooltip.summary: _Decorate_ your _Shafts, Cogwheels_ and _Pipes_ with a cozy and wooden bit of reinforcement.

names.create:builders_tea.tooltip.summary: The perfect drink to get the day started- _Motivating_ and _Saturating._
names.create:cardboard_sword.tooltip.summary: Bonk. A _mostly_ _harmless_, yet powerful weapon of choice.

names.create:copper_diving_boots.tooltip.summa: A pair of _heavy_ _boots_, allowing for better traversal of the Ocean floor.
names.create:copper_diving_helmet.tooltip.beha: Provides the _Water Breathing_ effect, slowly draining _Air Pressure_ from the Backtank.

names.create:empty_schematic.tooltip.summary: Used as a recipe ingredient and for writing at the _Schematic Table_.
names.create:experience_nugget.tooltip.summary: A speck of _inspiration_ from your fantastic inventions.
names.create:extendo_grip.tooltip.behaviour1: Increases _reach distance_ of items used in the _Main-Hand_.
names.create:extendo_grip.tooltip.behaviour2: _No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
names.create:extendo_grip.tooltip.summary: Greatly _increases reach distance_ of the wielder. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
names.create:filter.tooltip.summary: _Matches items_ against a collection of _items_ or _other filters_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components

Places the Controller into the Lectern for easy activation. (R-Click while Sneaking to retrieve it)

names.create:netherite_backtank.tooltip.behavi: Provides _Pressurized_ _Air_ to Equipment that requires it.

names.fluid:baton.tooltip.summary: Used to configure interaction points for _Mechanical Arm_, _Mechanical Pipette_, _Ejector Depot_, _Packager_, _Re-packager_, _Package Frogport_ and _Postbox_
names.fluid:slime_fluid_bucket.tooltip.summary: Used as a catalyst for _Bulk Glueing_ when placed in front of an _Encased Fan_
names.fluid:haunting_fluid_bucket.tooltip.summ: Used as a catalyst for _Bulk Haunting_ when placed in front of an _Encased Fan_
names.fluid:smoking_fluid_bucket.tooltip.summa: Used as a catalyst for _Bulk Smoking_ when placed in front of an _Encased Fan_
names.fluid:quicksand_bucket.tooltip.summary: Used as a catalyst for _Bulk Sandblasting_ when placed in front of an _Encased Fan_
names.fluid:copper_can.tooltip.summary: _Copper Cans_ are sturdier than cardboard packages. They carry a _single fluid_ stack up to _4000 mB_ and can be unpacked by a _Logistics Junction_ or another _Can Filler_.
names.fluid:brass_box.tooltip.summary: _Brass Boxes_ are mixed cargo packages. They can carry regular items together with up to _4 fluid stacks_, while preserving package routing for _Logistics Junctions_.
names.fluid:fluid_manifest.tooltip.summary: Right-click a fluid source, container, bucket, bottle, or tank to sample its contents. _Sneak-right-click_ to clear. Can be used to set fluids in Factory Gauges, Redstone Requesters, and other components.
names.fluid:smart_repackager.tooltip.summary: Re-packs _cardboard packages_, _Copper Cans_, and similar logistics carriers into _Brass Boxes_, marking their _upper and lower routing_ information. _Brass Boxes_ can only be unpacked by _Logistics Junctions_; the vertical arrangement of _Factory Gauges_ on a wall affects how Logistics Junctions route package contents between upper and lower outputs.
names.fluid:redstone_valve.tooltip.summary: A fluid valve that can be turned on and off with a redstone signal.
names.fluid:redstone_triple_valve.tooltip.summ: A fluid pipe whose turning direction can be controlled with a redstone signal.
names.kindurtowns:charter.tooltip: Right-click to open towns, nations and wars
names.kindurtowns:admin_charter.tooltip: Right-click to manage every town. Administrators only.
names.powergrid:circuit_design_table.tooltip.b: Writes the current design into a schematic item
names.powergrid:circuit_design_table.tooltip.s: Design and write _Circuit Schematics_. If you want to place components, you must have them in your inventory.
names.powergrid:creative_current_source.toolti: An _almost perfect_ current source. Set the output current with the _slider_ or _/powergrid_ command.
names.powergrid:creative_voltage_source.toolti: An _almost perfect_ voltage source. Set the output voltage with the _slider_ or _/powergrid_ command.
names.powergrid:fe_inverter.tooltip.summary: Converts _Forge Energy_ into _Electricity_ using advanced technology. Use the _Control Pin_ to adjust the output voltage and improve power conversion.
names.powergrid:potato_battery.tooltip.summary: An all natural source of green energy
names.powergrid:thermometer.tooltip.behaviour1: Measures the temperature of the device it is pointed at
names.powergrid:thermometer.tooltip.behaviour2: Measures current and maximum temperature of the device it is placed on over time
names.powergrid:thermometer.tooltip.summary: A simple device which measures the temperature of things
names.powergrid:circuit_schematic.tooltip.crea: Sneak right-click to convert into an assembled circuit
names.powergrid:electrobaton.tooltip.behaviour: Attacked enemies will be _stunned_ and _no durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery

names.powergrid:electrozapper.tooltip.behaviou: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
names.powergrid:electrozapper.tooltip.summary: Fires a lightning bolt that bounces off of nearby enemies, splitting the damage between them. Can be powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
names.powergrid:incomplete_circuit.tooltip.sum: Use _Mechanical Arms_ to insert used components and complete the circuit
names.powergrid:integrated_circuit.tooltip.sum: The integrated circuit is back! By deploying a circuit over a _compatible_ piece of equipment, you can _boost_ it, improving its _performance_ for a _limited_ number of uses. Beware, once boosted, the item will consume _twice_ as much power.
names.powergrid:multimeter.tooltip.behaviour1: Can be used to probe voltage between terminals and current flowing through wires
names.powergrid:multimeter.tooltip.summary: A multi-purpose tool, handful to anyone who wants to play with electricity
names.powergrid:pentode.tooltip.behaviour1: The _Screen_ must be positively biased. It shields the anode from the control grid and allows higher gain than a triode.
names.powergrid:pentode.tooltip.summary: A vacuum tube like a triode, with an extra _Screen Grid_ (G2) between the control grid and the anode for higher gain.
names.powergrid:portable_battery.tooltip.behav: Provides _Energy_ to Equipment that requires it
Stores energy at a rate depending on the _Supplied Voltage_
names.powergrid:portable_drill.tooltip.behavio: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
names.powergrid:portable_drill.tooltip.summary: Mines blocks with the strength of a diamond. When powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_, it mines faster the longer you use it.
names.powergrid:portable_saw.tooltip.behaviour: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
Sneak to harvests whole trees at once
names.powergrid:portable_saw.tooltip.summary: A saw for sawing wood. Can be powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
names.powergrid:thyratron.tooltip.behaviour1: Fires when anode voltage exceeds the strike voltage set by the _Grid_. A positive grid pulse can trigger conduction.
names.powergrid:thyratron.tooltip.behaviour2: Stays _latched on_ even if the grid is driven negative. Extinguishes only when anode current drops below holding or reverses.
names.powergrid:thyratron.tooltip.summary: A gas-filled tube that latches on when anode voltage exceeds a grid-controlled strike voltage. Once fired, the grid loses control until anode current drops or reverses.
names.powergrid:triode.tooltip.behaviour1: Conducts from _Anode_ to _Cathode_. A small change in _Grid_ voltage produces a large change in anode current.
names.powergrid:triode.tooltip.summary: A vacuum tube that amplifies signals. Anode current is controlled by a small voltage on the _Grid_.
names.powergrid:wire_cutter.tooltip.behaviour1: Removes a hanging wire, or selected segment of a block wire
names.powergrid:wire_cutter.tooltip.condition2: When Shift R-Clicked on a block wire
